name: What is a 1031 Exchange and how can it benefit me with multifamily property?

mainEntity.name: What is a 1031 Exchange and how can it benefit me with multifamily property?

acceptedAnswer.text: A 1031 Exchange allows real estate investors to defer capital gains taxes when selling an investment property and reinvesting the proceeds into a 'like-kind' property. For multifamily properties, this means you can sell one apartment building or complex and purchase another, postponing tax obligations. This strategy can significantly increase your purchasing power for a new investment, enabling you to acquire a larger property or one with greater income potential. Understanding the eligibility criteria and strict timelines is crucial for a successful exchange.
acceptedAnswer.description: A 1031 Exchange allows real estate investors to defer capital gains taxes when selling an investment property and reinvesting into a like-kind property, such as another multifamily building.
